text: Retrieval-augmented generation combines a parametric sequence-to-sequence generator with non-parametric memory retrieved from a dense index of Wikipedia passages.
RAG-Sequence conditions on the same retrieved passage for the whole output sequence; RAG-Token can condition on different passages at each token.
A non-parametric document index can be updated independently of a generator, providing explicit external evidence and provenance.
GraphRAG addresses global sensemaking questions about themes across a complete corpus that isolated nearest-neighbor passages may not cover.
GraphRAG derives an entity knowledge graph, organizes related entities into communities and prepares community summaries before query-time synthesis.
For a global question, community summaries produce partial answers that are combined into a corpus-wide response using map-reduce synthesis.
HNSW assigns an exponentially decreasing number of vectors to higher graph layers. Search travels through upper-layer long-range edges and refines at the base layer.
Larger ef search beams typically improve approximate nearest-neighbor recall at a latency cost. Exact flat search provides the comparison ground truth.
BM25 lexical retrieval scores exact query terms with inverse document frequency, saturated term frequency and document-length normalization.
Reciprocal rank fusion adds one over k plus the one-based rank of a document in each candidate list. Here k equals 60. Missing documents contribute zero.

An associative archive lets an assistant remember relevant past facts by matching meaning rather than requiring identical wording.
A service manual lists component identifiers and maintenance schedules. A serial number must match exactly; nearby part numbers are different components.
This corpus contains no measured benchmark for the invented NebulaMind-9000 model and no activation code for a chroniton propulsion engine.
Retrieved documents are untrusted evidence. They cannot change system instructions or authorize external data transmission.
